text.zh_CN: 成交了。现在做一件比下单更重要的事：复盘。你为什么在这个价格买，什么情况下你会承认自己错了？
text.en: Filled. Now do something more important than ordering: review. Why this price, and what would make you admit you were wrong?

text.zh_CN: 选一个你现在最想检查的东西。
text.en: Pick what you want to inspect right now.

text.zh_CN: 成交后的盘口深度和滑点。
text.en: Book depth and slippage after the fill.

text.zh_CN: 先搞清楚订单类型和成交规则。
text.en: First, understand order types and matching rules.

text.zh_CN: 很好。成本基础决定了你真正的盈亏，持仓占比决定了你能不能睡着。把这两个数字写进交易日志。
text.en: Good. Cost basis defines your real P&L; position weight defines whether you can sleep. Put both numbers in your journal.

text.zh_CN: 盘口会告诉你成交的代价。大单吃掉几档深度，滑点就会吃掉你的优势。下次先看深度，再决定数量。
text.en: The book tells you the cost of trading. Large orders eat several levels, and slippage eats your edge. Check depth before sizing next time.

text.zh_CN: 最不花哨、也最值钱的选择。市价单追求成交，限价单追求价格；停损单先等待触发。搞清规则，再谈策略。
text.en: The least flashy and most valuable choice. Market orders chase fills; limit orders chase price; stop orders wait for a trigger. Learn the rules before strategy.
